facts.fact: Adwave's listed price is from $30 a day, prepaid, according to the Adwave pricing page checked Nov 3, 2026.
Vibe's pricing starts at $50 a day, per the Vibe pricing page checked Nov 3, 2026.
MNTN's calculator examples start at $5,000 a month, and MNTN says those figures are calculator inputs rather than a minimum; its MCP post states no minimum.
facts.quote: No minimum in its MCP post. Calculator examples start at $5,000 a month, and MNTN says those are calculator inputs

facts.fact: Adspirer's free tier includes 15 tasks a month, and its $40 a month plan includes campaign creation.
facts.quote: Free for 15 tasks a month. $40 a month includes campaign creation

facts.fact: Pipeboard's free tier allows 30 tool runs a week, and its Pro plan costs $29.90 a month.
facts.quote: Free for 30 tool runs a week. Pro is $29.90 a month

facts.fact: Ryze costs $89 a month with a 7-day trial.
Adwave's ChatGPT launch capability requires a ChatGPT Business or Enterprise plan.
Adwave's launch and resume actions set the day's budget aside, and what runs is charged the next morning.
facts.quote: Launching and resuming set the day’s budget aside, and what ran is charged the next morning.

facts.fact: On Adwave, TikTok is opt-in early access and Pinterest is listed as coming soon.
facts.quote: On Adwave, TikTok is opt-in early access and Pinterest is coming soon.

facts.fact: Meta Ads AI Connectors start new items paused by default, according to the Meta docs checked Nov 3, 2026.
facts.quote: New items start paused by default

facts.fact: Adspirer creates campaigns in a paused state, and nothing goes live until the user confirms.
facts.quote: Creates campaigns paused. Nothing goes live until you confirm

facts.fact: The Google Ads MCP server has no tool for creating campaigns; it reads reporting and creates assets and labels.
facts.quote: It reads reporting and creates assets and labels, with no tool for creating campaigns

facts.fact: Amazon Ads MCP server, in open beta, can create, update and delete campaigns, per the Amazon Ads announcement dated Feb 2, 2026.
facts.quote: Yes. It can create, update and delete campaigns

facts.fact: AdRoll's MCP server drafts changes first for user review before they go live, per the May 27, 2026 release.
facts.quote: Drafts first, for your review before changes go live

facts.fact: The comparison covers twelve tools that let an AI assistant work on ads.
facts.quote: Twelve tools that let an AI assistant work on your ads, compared by use case with sources and dates.

facts.fact: Vendor tool prices on the page exclude the media a buyer purchases, unless the tool sells media itself.
facts.quote: vendor prices exclude the media you buy, unless the tool sells media itself

facts.fact: MNTN states it is live in the Claude and ChatGPT app directories; the article reports this as MNTN's own statement and says the authors could not verify it.
facts.quote: We report that as MNTN’s statement, because we couldn’t check those directories ourselves.
